Container.Name: storage-node
Container.Overview: Runs storage nodes for our decentralised storage network. Each node stores encrypted pieces of uploaded files, proves it still holds them, and earns storage fees in the network's token, paid to your wallet. Forward the UDP ports (two per node: storage and browser) from your router to this server.

Config.Name: Rewards wallet
Config.Description: Ethereum-style wallet address (0x...) that receives your storage fees.

Config.Name: Number of nodes
Config.Description: How many nodes to run (1-6). Each uses one UDP port.

Config.Name: Storage limit (GB)
Config.Description: The most disk space all the nodes together will use, in GB (1000 = 1 TB). 0 means no limit: they fill the disk up to its last 500 MB.

Config.Name: First UDP port
Config.Description: Nodes use this port and the ones after it. Forward them all (UDP) on your router.

Config.Name: First browser UDP port
Config.Description: Each node also serves web browsers on this port and the ones after it. Forward them all (UDP) on your router too, same numbers outside and inside. 0 turns browser access off.

Config.Name: Data folder
Config.Description: Where stored data lives. Use the SSD cache pool, not the parity array.

Config.Name: Blockchain RPC
Config.Description: Robinhood Chain RPC the nodes use to check payments. The default is free; you can use your own provider's link.

Config.Name: IPv4 only
Config.Description: Set to true if your connection has no working IPv6.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the nodes run as (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the nodes run as (100 = users on Unraid).
